newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BOOKMAKERS LAY ODDS ON PALACE REVOLUTION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOOKMAKERS LAY ODDS ON PALACE REVOLUTION.

text.p: A Palace revolution looks likely in English soccer next season, according to London bookmakers William Hill.
Starting their annual "sack race" -- the odds on premier league managers most likely to lose their jobs by the season's end -- the bookmakers listed Crystal Palace's Steve Coppell as 5-4 favourite.
The most secure job in the league was perhaps inevitably to be found at the Arsenal.
The north London club's French manager Arsene Wenger, who has been on a high-profile spending spree over the summer, was given 16-1 odds.
History, however, teaches that there are no certainties, with Newcastle's Kevin Keegan causing an upset last season when he left the club. He had started out as a remote 20-1 bet.
Champions Manchester United were 6-4 favourites to lift the title once again, with Newcastle 7-2. Newly-promoted Barnsley were 1000-1 outsiders.
